judgment_text:
PETITION filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of India praying for the issuance of writ of certiorarified Mandamus to call for the records pertaining to the impugned order letter No. 769/MU U1/2025 dated 29-1-2026, passed by the 2nd respondent and quash the same and consecutively direct the 2nd respondent to grant ordinary leave for 28 days without escort to the detenue, Abishek, S/o Narayanan aged about 29 years, convict prisoner, bearing PID No. 86821, confined at central prison, Puzhal and pass such further or other orders as this Court may deem fit to the circumstances of the case and thus render justice.

The Order of the Court was delivered by

Dr Anita Sumanth, J.:— Mr M. Ezhilarasu, learned counsel for the petitioner seeks permission to withdraw this Writ Petition and has made an endorsement to this effect.

2. Recording the endorsement made, this Writ Petition (Crl.) and the connected Miscellaneous Petition are dismissed as withdrawn.
